title: RNA Isolation and cDNA Synthesis from Sphaeroforma arctica
author: Sebastián R. Najle
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wqdfds6

steps.title: Harvest and Pellet Cells
steps.instruction: Collect cells from culture flasks and pellet them via centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Remove cells from culture flasks using a cell scraper (Nunc).
Transfer cells to a 15 ml centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 4500 xg for 5 min at 12 °C.
Carefully remove supernatant by pipetting, avoiding perturbation of the pellet.

steps.title: Cell Lysis and Freeze-Thaw Cycles
steps.instruction: Lyse cells using TRIzol and perform freeze-thaw cycles to disrupt the sample.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 1 mL of TRIzol (ThermoFisher Scientific) by gently pipetting until completely dissolved.
Incubate the suspension for 5 min at room temperature.
Transfer the suspension to a new 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube with safe lock (Eppendorf).
Freeze the tube by submerging it in liquid nitrogen until it stops boiling.
Thaw the solution for 5 min in a thermal block pre-warmed at 50 °C.
Repeat the freeze-thaw cycle once.

steps.title: Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Separate RNA from DNA and proteins using 1-bromo-3-chloropropane.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL of 1-bromo-3-chloropropane (Sigma-Aldrich) to the tube.
Cap the tube and seal with parafilm.
Shake the tube vigorously by hand for 15 seconds.
Incubate at room temperature for 15 min.
Centrifuge at 12,000 xg for 15 min at 4 °C.
Carefully transfer the superior aqueous phase (approximately 600 µL) to a clean 1.5 mL tube, avoiding the interphase (gDNA) and lower phase (proteins).

steps.title: RNA Precipitation and Washing
steps.instruction: Precipitate the RNA and wash the pellet to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL of isopropanol, invert 3-4 times to mix, and incubate for 15 min at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 12,000 xg for 10 min at 4 °C.
Discard the supernatant.
Add 1 ml of freshly prepared 75% ethanol, vortex briefly, and centrifuge at 8,500 xg for 5 min at 4 °C.
Discard the supernatant completely and air-dry at room temperature for about 10 min (avoid overdrying).

steps.title: RNA Resuspension and Quantification
steps.instruction: Resuspend the RNA pellet and measure its concentration.

substeps.instruction: Add 30 to 50 µL of nuclease-free water.
Resuspend by gently pipetting while heating at 56 °C.
Spin down to collect the volume at the bottom.
Measure RNA concentration using spectrophotometry (e.g., NanoDrop).

steps.title: DNAse Treatment
steps.instruction: Remove contaminating genomic DNA using DNAse I.

substeps.instruction: Transfer up to 10 µg of total RNA to a clean tube.
Add nuclease-free water to reach a final volume of 40.5 µl.
Add 5 µl 10X DNAseI buffer (Thermofisher), 2 µl RNAseOUT (Thermofisher), and 5 µl DNAseI (Thermofisher).
Incubate at room temperature for 15 min.
Inactivate the reaction by adding 1 µl EDTA solution and incubating for 10 min at 65 °C.

steps.title: RNA Purification and Final Resuspension
steps.instruction: Purify the DNAse-treated RNA via LiCl precipitation.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 µl of 5M LiCl and two volumes (110 µl) of 100% ethanol (pre-cooled at -20 °C).
Precipitate overnight at -80 °C.
Centrifuge at maximum speed for 15 min at 4 °C and carefully discard the supernatant.
Wash once with 1 ml 70% ethanol (cold at -20 °C).
Centrifuge at maximum speed for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, and air-dry at room temperature for 10-15 min (avoid overdrying).
Resuspend the pellet with 20 µl of nuclease-free water by pipetting up and down.
Flick the tube, spin down, and incubate overnight at -80 °C for complete resuspension.

steps.title: Final RNA Quantification
steps.instruction: Measure the concentration of the purified RNA using spectrophotometry (e.g., NanoDrop).

steps.title: cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Synthesize first-strand cDNA using SuperScript III.

substeps.instruction: Calculate volume for 0.5 to 3 µg of RNA (volume must not exceed 8 µl).
In a DNA LoBind 0.5 µl tube (or normal PCR tube), assemble: x µl Total RNA, (8-x) µl Nuclease-free water, 1 µl oligo dT primer, and 1 µl 10X dNTP mix.
Heat the mix for 5 min at 65 °C on a thermocycler, then cool immediately on ice.
While on ice, add 10 µl of cDNA reaction mix containing: 2 µl 10X Superscript III buffer, 4 µl 25 mM MgCl2, 2 µl 0.1 M DTT, 1 µl RNAseOUT, and 1 µl Superscript III.
Homogenize, spin down, and incubate for 75 min at 50 °C.
Incubate for 5 min at 85 °C to inactivate the enzyme.
Treat samples with 1 µl RNAse H (from SuperScript kit) for 1 hour at 37 °C in a water bath.
